label: A word waiting for its fixed partner, read on the first piece: ' such' before 'as' (fruits such as), 'according' before 'to', the ' well' in ', as well as', the contraction stems isn/wasn/don/won/aren before 't, and the lone space before a number (born in 1987, platform 7). Also the same stem at the start of a longer word (' Don' in 'Donations') and the 'e' of '(e.g.'; split Japanese kanji only weakly. Quiet when the word is used freely (it was such a, sings well, in order to, Prime Minister, can't, I'm, does not, numbers spelled out).
